headline: Major Overnight Drone Raid on Moscow Prompts Airport Shutdowns
summary: Hundreds of long-range strike drones targeted Moscow and the surrounding region, prompting authorities to close Vnukovo, Domodedovo, and regional airports.
why: Large-scale aerial drone incursions on capital city infrastructure disrupt commercial aviation and escalate geopolitical conflict risks.

impacts.name: Russia
impacts.why: Airports and capital airspace were restricted due to drone strikes.
